title: The Warden Scythe
description: This datapack add a powerful weapon but hard to get !
body:
# The Warden Scythe

**This datapack allows you to make a powerful weapon called the Warden Scythe !**
![The Warden Scythe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f8a2cedb4f9897b0a8659e725b23ce87d8d37e5_0.webp)

## Warden Scythe stats:
- Attack damage : 12 (6 hearts)
- Attack speed : 1.3
- Sweeping Damage ratio 1
- Entity Reach : 4.5
- Breach II stored enchant
- Special : Sonic boom attack on right click (5s cooldown)

## Steps for get the warden scythe:
- 1 Get a warden head, a nether star, 2 netherite ingots and 3 echo shards
- 2 Do this craft to get an Unfinished Scythe
  
![Unifinished Scythe craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b40bffab688f4537e4193c30a30d2911be94ea19.png)

- 3 put a warden in your off hand and the unfinished scythe in your mainhand and you will get the warden scythe !

**But The Warden and The Wither got very stronger ! Be careful while fighting them !**
